scan_logic: Projects where the 7d fundamental momentum (composite of: developer activity Δ, GitHub commits Δ, revenue Δ, partnership announcements, TVL inflow) is ≥ 2.0 standard deviations above the 90-day baseline.

opportunities.name: Bittensor
signal_triggers: Subnet count crossed 47 — new all-time high
Two major partnerships announced (NVIDIA, Google Cloud)
dTAO emissions rebalancing increased network efficiency +18%
opportunities.ai_investment_opinion: Bittensor enters a confirmed structural uptrend. Subnet expansion combined with dTAO emissions rebalancing creates a positive feedback loop for both developer activity and network revenue. Pullbacks toward 30-day moving average are buyable.
risk_factors: Subnet concentration risk — top 5 subnets hold 62% of TAO emissions

opportunities.name: Render Network
signal_triggers: Apple Vision Pro studio partnership expanded node utilization +24%
Monthly revenue crossed $1.8M for the first time
New migration layer from Solana to Base reduced fees 38%
opportunities.ai_investment_opinion: Render is the cleanest expression of the AI compute theme. Real revenue, growing node count, defensible positioning. Pullback to 50-day MA is the highest-quality re-entry in the DePIN space.
risk_factors: Sole reliance on a few large studios for demand concentration

opportunities.name: Akash Network
opportunities.ai_investment_opinion: Akash is the most credible open-source alternative to AWS for AI workloads. H100 launch is a structural catalyst. Position sized to growth-stage DePIN risk.
risk_factors: Competition from Render and io.net for GPU capacity

opportunities.name: Injective
opportunities.ai_investment_opinion: EVM compatibility is a meaningful catalyst. The real test will be whether institutional DeFi apps build on Injective vs. staying on Base/Arbitrum. Watch TVL growth through Q3.
risk_factors: L1 competition is intense; EVM-launch may not be enough to win wallet share

opportunities.name: io.net
signal_triggers: Solana partnership for AI inference workloads
New enterprise tier with SLA guarantees
opportunities.ai_investment_opinion: Largest distributed GPU cluster by raw count. Watch burn rate and customer concentration carefully. The cluster is the moat; execution is the variable.
risk_factors: Customer concentration — top 5 customers likely 40%+ of revenue
Token unlock Q4 2026 — supply pressure building

opportunities.name: Ondo Finance
signal_triggers: USDY APY exceeded 5.0% for first time since 2024
opportunities.ai_investment_opinion: Ondo remains the highest-quality RWA exposure. Revenue and TVL both inflecting upward. BlackRock partnership is a structural moat that compounds.
risk_factors: Regulatory risk in the US for yield-bearing products

opportunities.name: Filecoin
opportunities.ai_investment_opinion: Network fundamentals are quietly inflecting. Filecoin Plus is working. This is a slow-burn re-rating story, not a momentum trade. Position sized accordingly.
risk_factors: Storage demand is concentrated in a small number of large clients

opportunities.name: Fetch.ai
signal_triggers: ASI Alliance merger catalyst still pricing in
opportunities.ai_investment_opinion: The agent narrative is real but the bar to win is rising. Fetch's main risk is the ASI Alliance integration distracting from product velocity. Watch developer growth.
